evidence_tier: development fold 0, three seeds, same architecture; the added channels come from the raw record and are appended to the frozen arrays, which are asserted unchanged
definition: per vital sign, how many times it was charted in the hour and the spread of the charted values; plus all recorded items per hour. These are discarded by the hourly median every existing model uses.
reading: genuinely new information from the same source records does not improve the volume endpoint either; the endpoint is limited by the information content of the record, not by which model reads it
